purpose: Explore a new modular night-fortress composition and measure whether its identity survives native-scale conversion and repeated-tile cost. Not final SGDK pixel art.
prompt_brief: Original wide Japanese night-fortress fighting-stage concept; keep right of center, far watchtower, moon, broad cloud silhouettes, continuous wooden fighting deck, modular masonry/rail/board motifs, cool night colors and restrained amber lanterns. Preserve a quiet playable floor and readable fighter silhouettes at 320x224. No text, HUD, fighters, logos, gradient, blur, fake scanlines, photoreal detail, or copied commercial art.
lineage_limitation: The selected file is hash-bound, but the exact generation prompt and first-generation intermediate were not persisted. No claim of exact prompt reproducibility is made.
